description: 976 Potentiel photovoltaïque des surfaces au sol is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.observatoire-de-mayotte.fr. Cadastre solaire sur Mayotte. Cette donnée concerne spécifiquement l'irradiation solaire des surfaces au sol disponibles. Coverage: FR. Its keywords include 976, cadastre solaire, sol, Mayotte. The listing shows 2 download or service links in SHP. The listing shows 2020-07-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
